catalogue.reg_photo_id: Government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, …)
catalogue.reg_address_proof: Proof of address of the business premises (if different from the photo ID)
catalogue.directors_list: List of directors / partners / proprietor with full address and contact details, nominating an authorised signatory (on letterhead)
catalogue.photo_id_signatory: Photo ID and address proof of the proprietor / partners / directors / authorised signatory
catalogue.premises_proof: Proof of possession of premises (sale deed, rent agreement, electricity bill, …)
catalogue.constitution: Partnership deed / self-declaration for proprietorship / memorandum & articles of association / co-operative certificate
catalogue.form_ix: Form IX: nomination of a person under the FSS Rules (not for a proprietor) (on letterhead)
catalogue.layout_plan: Blueprint / layout plan of the processing unit with dimensions and operation-wise areas (on letterhead)
catalogue.equipment_list: List of equipment and machinery with number, installed capacity and horse power (on letterhead)
catalogue.water_report: Chemical and bacteriological analysis of water used as an ingredient, from a recognised or public health laboratory (not needed if water is not an ingredient)
catalogue.iec: Import Export Code (IEC) issued by DGFT
catalogue.export_declaration: Declaration that export-only products will not be sold in India and meet the importing country's standards (on letterhead)
catalogue.eou_certificate: Ministry of Commerce certificate for 100% EOU
catalogue.vehicle_list: List of vehicle registration numbers (on letterhead)
catalogue.milk_source_plan: Source or procurement plan for milk (on letterhead)
catalogue.municipal_noc: NOC from the Municipal Corporation / local body
catalogue.product_specification: Product specification of each product with the purity criteria of ingredients, in the prescribed format (on letterhead)
catalogue.composition: Composition of each product in the prescribed format (on letterhead)
catalogue.product_approval: Product approval from FSSAI HQ for each product
catalogue.pesticide_report: Pesticide residue report of the water used, with source of raw water and treatment plan
